name: climaflux-erp
description: ClimaFlux ERP com fundação SaaS multiempresa, autenticação Google, D1, RBAC no servidor, auditoria e API de clientes.

scripts.check: node --check worker/auth-core.js && node --check worker/policy.js && node --check worker/security.js && node --check worker/auth.js && node --check worker/index.js && node --check auth/login.js && node --check auth/auth-client.js && node --check auth/admin-access.js && node --check auth/customers-saas.js && node --check auth/secure-sw.js && node --check scripts/build-public.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:public
scripts.serve: npm run build:public && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory public
